what: Plan offers two denominators: availability formula `4*(cursor+codex)` floored at 4 OR `STATIC_SLOT_COUNT` from dispatch
scenario_or_breakage: Recomputing from flags can diverge from emitted manifest rows (e.g. flags both true but dispatch emits 4 rows) yielding INTENDED=8 and LAUNCHED=4, so NEVER_LAUNCHED adds 4 phantom failures and a healthy panel hard-stops
suggested_fix: In review-core.sh set `intended_slots="$static_slot_count"` (same KV as `--launched-slots`) and pass `--intended-slots "$intended_slots"`; drop the parallel availability formula from the plan
